article.story: BLACKSBURG, Va. -- — Amani Hansberry scored 20 points on 6-for-10 shooting, Isaiah Elohim set a career-high with 16 points, and Virginia Tech defeated Mount St. Mary's 82-62 on Friday night. The Hokies (4-0) forced 23 turnovers and held Mount St. Mary's to just 48 field-goal attempts. They won the rebound battle 41-32, and had 14 steals. Elohim was 6-for-12 shooting (2 for 3 from deep) and grabbed five rebounds. Ben Hammond had 18 points and eight assists, and Tyler Johnson had a game-high nine boards. Virginia Tech scored 11 seconds in, opened the game on a 7-0 run, and added an 11-0 run just before the end of the first half to lead 42-30 at the break. The Mountaineers (1-2) cut the lead to as few as seven with 6:32 remaining thanks to a 7-1 run, but the Hokies responded with a 15-2 run of their own that gave them their largest lead of the night with just 2:29 remaining. Redd Thompson Jr. led the Mountaineers with 15 points (4-for-9 shooting), and fellow reserve Wilguens Junior Exacte added 12. Yakhya Diop grabbed seven rebounds. Up next Mount St. Mary's: hosts Lehigh on Tuesday. Virginia Tech: hosts Richmond on Monday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
